players.name: Arvell Reese
players.comment: Reese logged 13 tackles (four solo) in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Micah McFadden
players.comment: McFadden made 10 tackles (five solo) in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Ar'Darius Washington
players.comment: Washington accumulated seven tackles (five solo) and two passes defensed, including one interception, in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Jevon Holland
players.comment: Holland logged three tackles (one solo) and one pass defensed for an interception in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Dominic Zvada
players.comment: Zvada missed his only field-goal try and made all three of his PATs on Thursday in a loss to Washington.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.comment: Nabers secured five of seven targets for 44 yards and lost a fumble in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Malachi Fields
players.comment: Fields brought in three of four targets for 62 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Darnell Mooney
players.comment: Mooney caught two of five targets for eight yards Thursday in a loss to Washington.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.comment: McCarthy completed 23 of 36 passes for 293 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding six rushes for 34 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.comment: Likely (undisclosed) wasn't spotted at Friday's practice, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Travon Walker
players.comment: Walker (ribs) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

players.name: Jordan Davis
players.comment: Davis is slated to make his Jaguars debut Sunday against the Giants, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Foyesade Oluokun
players.comment: Oluokun finished Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans with 10 tackles (nine solo).

players.name: Travis Hunter
players.comment: Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards, recorded a three-yard carry and contributed five tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.

players.name: Jessie Bates III
players.comment: Bates is slated to make his Jaguars debut Sunday against the Giants, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Antonio Johnson
players.comment: Johnson (ankle) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Giants.

players.name: Cam Little
players.comment: Little went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made all four of his PATs during Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.comment: Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.comment: Meyers (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.comment: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.

players.name: Robert Hainsey
players.comment: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen announced Wednesday that Hainsey (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

players.name: Trevor Lawrence
players.comment: Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.comment: Tuten (ankle/foot) was present for the stretching portion of Friday's practice before moving to a side field, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
